evidence: 2D and 3d_top views show visible gaps between all bodies, including between each THT screw-terminal body and the lowest channel passive above it and within the tight C1/R9/R10 cluster beside U1.
Screw terminals J1-J4 sit on the bottom edge with openings facing outward and a clear path to the edge, but pin header J5 is placed mid-board well inside the top edge rather than at a board edge.
All four ADC channels use an identical vertical C-D-R-R strip at even column pitch, with components forming aligned rows (C2-C5, D1-D4, R2/R4/R6/R8, R1/R3/R5/R7) across the board.
In the 2D view the R10, R9 and C1 designators beside U1 stack directly on top of one another and over their footprints, making them illegible, while channel designators elsewhere are clean.
The upper-left and upper-right thirds of the board are large empty dead zones while U1's support passives are crammed into one congested cluster, so board area is used disproportionately.
